title: Rosehill and Camellia families: a genuinely eggless cake, 5 minutes away
summary:
Rosehill and Camellia sit a few minutes from Wigram Street. Close enough that a genuinely eggless cake shouldn't mean a trip into the city.

Num Nums has been 100% eggless since 2019 — not some cakes, every cake. Jain-friendly and halal-friendly as standard, no special requests needed. 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, six sizes, buttercream, fondant, or ganache.

Every cake is fresh to order, which is why we ask for 48 hours' notice, not less. Open until 10pm daily, so pickup fits around your evening, not the other way round.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati.
